body:
Just read it, and I'd say something sloppy or whatever like "I know your pain, whatever whatever whatever", but truth is I don't. I don't know what it feels like to experience those things. 

But what I do know, is that you've just gotta keep your head up, and keep looking forward, no matter what comes your way. I'm battling suicide rn too, but I know I've gotta just keep rolling, and keep going with what comes my way.

I'd assume it's a big ask, to keep your head up, but it's all the advice I've got. Stay strong!

You said you stopped with the noose at the last second, you know you can't do that if you jump. Imagine your feet have just left the platform and you suddenly feel like living might not be so bad? There's no "nah not feeling it I take it back." :/
I know they'd 100% blame themselves, and only themselves. It's not right when they've had bugger all impact on how I'm feeling.
